title: Music City Getaway
description:
If you like country music, this is your place. Just 25 minutes from the honky tonks of Nashville, this quiet neighborhood was the place where legends like Johnny Cash, Roy Orbeson, the Mandrells, Connie Smith and Marty Stuart lived. This two bedroom, one bath apartment is just one mile from Old Hickory Lake and two public boat ramps. The property has space for either a boat or RV as well as a sports pool to cool off on hot days.

The space
The unit is on the second floor, so there is one flight of steps.

Other things to note
The unit is on the second floor, so there is one flight of steps.  The pool is generally open around the first day of spring to some time in October.  It depends on the weather.
